_doc: Hunters vs Farmers AI settings (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §10, stream E; js/sim/modes/hvf/ai/). The three levels differ in DECISIONS: same rules, same commands, same vision. reaction = ticks between thinks (20 = 1 s). farm: hiding random | best | spread (best-scored hollow, spread from allies, briar door preferred); fleeAt = run when a hunter is seen this close (m); lieLow = may Lie Low in cover instead of running; bellAt = strays before ringing the Bell; sheepdog = builds one; door = hedges every gap into home; towers = arrow towers once home is found (towersAlways: also once 4 producers stand); farmhouseAt = producers before a Farmhouse (-1 never); tellWeight = how much loudness (tell 0-3) cuts a producer's value (towerQuiet / hedgeQuiet: how much each tower / a hedged door lowers that); crowd = how much crowding home cuts an animal producer's value (0 = ignores it); expand = chops trees to grow home; spillOut = builds outside home when it is full; sprawl = builds on the open ground around home FIRST, trails included (the careless farmer); second = moves on to another hollow when home is full (maxHollows in all); noise = random jitter on build choices; pullRange / reviveRange / graveWatch (m) = watchstones pulled near home, graves revived within, a grave a hunter was seen near lately is left alone; flip rarely | income | turn = when to build the Harvest Hall and march (turn: when the Turn moon says the army wins); crowsFirst = a crow flock before scarecrows. hunt: decay = suspicion kept per think (Recruit forgets fast); tracks = reads stray tracks; noise = weight of heard animals; memory = ticks it chases the last place a farmer was seen; chase = metres it will chase a seen farmer; retreatAt = health share at which it goes back to a lodge (0 never); priority = towers that shoot it, then a Farmhouse, then producers before anything else; camp = seconds it waits by a fresh grave for the farmers who come to revive (0 never); snares = sets snares; wards = watchstones standing; wardChokes = weighs junctions by how many trails meet; hawk random | best; hornHeat = suspicion near it before the Horn; lodges = lodges it keeps standing (the kennel counts); lodgeReserve = gold kept besides a lodge's price; shop impulse | value | build (shopping lists in hunter.js); shopTrips = walks to a lodge to shop; turnAware = reads the Turn (avoid scarecrow packs, an extra lodge once the farmers lead).
